subject: Pilot toolkit: Restructure pricing for throughput-first pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@medcomply.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medcomply.io
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot toolkit: Restructure pricing for throughput-first pilot

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. MedComply is excited to start a 6-week pilot, but our priorities are slightly different than the sample configs you showed: we need to prioritize sustained throughput (we estimate ~5M tokens/day across peak shifts) and tighter p95 latency (~300ms) rather than adding more named seats.

Key asks from Procurement/Platform:
- Can we reallocate part of our seat spend into a throughput bucket that guarantees X tokens/day?
- We need audit logs, 30d retention in the hosted control plane, and VPC peering for data egress during the pilot — can those be bundled as a single pilot add-on?
- Target monthly budget for the pilot is ~$35k (including feature add-ons).

I've attached a short requirements brief (MedComply_Pilot_RQ.pdf). Can you sketch 2–3 concrete pricing + packaging options that map to a throughput-first pilot vs the usual seat-heavy pilots? Also flag any SLA or security evidence we need to provide to internal security.

Availability this week to review: Mon–Tue mornings ET.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedComply

Attachments: MedComply_Pilot_RQ.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@medcomply.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, procurement@medcomply.io
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 17:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot toolkit: Restructure pricing for throughput-first pilot

Hi Olivia —

Great context and budget clarity, thanks. I sketched three options below (high-level) that trade off between named seats and committed throughput: I've attached a quick workbook (pilot-options-draft.xlsx) with ballpark unit math.

Option A — Seat-preserve (conservative)
- Keep 3 named seats for product & engineering access; add a 2M token/day committed bucket for the pilot.
- Add-on bundle for audit logs + 30d retention + VPC peering: flat $6k/mo pilot fee.
- Pilot price estimate: ~$34k/mo (fits budget).

Option B — Throughput-shift (recommended for their workload)
- Convert 50% of seat budget into a 5M token/day committed throughput bucket (lower per-token unit price).
- Provide 1 named seat (admin) + shared seats via SSO for collaborators.
- Include pilot add-on bundle discounted to $4k/mo.
- Pilot price estimate: ~$32k/mo.

Option C — Hybrid credits (flexible)
- Pre-bought ‘pilot credits’ redeemable against tokens or short-term named seats. Good when usage is spiky.
- Pilot price estimate variable; recommend a not-to-exceed cap of $38k/mo.

Notes/constraints:
- Latency SLOs tied to model variant and routing policy; p95 300ms on hosted may require model quantization + kernel selection (we can recommend quant settings).
- VPC peering for hosted requires a short onboarding window (2–3 business days).

Next steps: Rishi, can you convert Option B into a committed-bucket pricing grid and suggest an introductory pilot discount we can offer? Ben/Kim — can you confirm whether the add-on bundle as described can be packaged as a single SKU and whether any SLA exception is reasonable for a 6-week pilot?

I’m free Mon 9:00–11:00 ET to walk through.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot-options-draft.xlsx
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@medcomply.io>
Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot toolkit: Restructure pricing for throughput-first pilot

Folks —

I ran the numbers and attached a pricing matrix (pricing-matrix.csv). High-level proposal:

- Pilot discount: 15% off list for the 6-week pilot (applies to tokens and add-ons).
- Committed throughput tiers (examples):
  * 2M tokens/day -> $22k/mo list -> $18.7k/mo pilot pricing
  * 5M tokens/day -> $38k/mo list -> $32.3k/mo pilot pricing (after 15% pilot discount)

- If MedComply converts the pilot into a Dedicated/reserved contract within 90 days, offer an additional conversion credit equal to 20% of pilot spend (applied as onboarding credit).

Add-on bundling:
- Audit logs + 30d retention + VPC peering can be bundled as a single add-on SKU. Current list is $6k/mo; suggest pilot price of $4k/mo (we can absorb margin for acquisition).

SLA exception: short-term SLA guarantees are ok for pilots if we mark them as ‘pilot SLOs’ in the amendment; full production SLAs would kick in on conversion. Legal will need to sign off but I think Procurement will accept pilot SLO language.

Ops note: quantization guidance — recommend int8 dynamic for the 5M bucket to hit p95 targets without dramatically changing model outputs.

I'll drop final grid into the HubSpot deal (MED-2028-PILOT-42) and link the DocuSign draft.

—Rishi

Attachment: pricing-matrix.csv
From: Olivia Park <olivia@medcomply.io>

Cc: procurement@medcomply.io, legal@medcomply.io

Subject: Re: Pilot toolkit: Restructure pricing for throughput-first pilot

Marcus / Rishi —

Thanks — the numbers land close to what Procurement wanted. A couple of asks before we can sign:
1) Can you produce a one-page amendment that lists Option B as the default pilot configuration (5M committed tokens/day, 1 named admin seat, add-on bundle $4k/mo) and the 15% pilot discount?
2) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short note on how audit logs are exported and retained during the pilot.
3) DocuSign link for signature — procurement needs to route it to our finance approver.

If you can get a DocuSign and the amendment over today, we can sign and start onboarding Tue morning.

Best,
Olivia
